data.title: Goldgroup Mining Reports Multi-Asset Drilling and Technical Work
data.description:
Goldgroup Mining ( (TSE:GORO) ) has provided an update.

On Nov. 6, 2026, Goldgroup Mining reported drilling, exploration and technical studies across its four 100%-owned precious-metals assets in Mexico and the United States. Work included a 26,000-metre San Francisco drilling program and mine-planning studies, resource replacement and regional exploration at Don David, sonic drilling tied to Cerro Prieto heap re-leaching, and a Back Forty feasibility study.

At Don David, the company said it had completed approximately 25,726 metres in 123 holes during the first seven months of 2026, with more than 97% directed to resource definition and expansion; at Cerro Prieto, 26 of 45 sonic holes totaling 1,009 of 1,554 metres had been drilled. The update described work spanning production, exploration and development, with stated objectives including resource growth or replacement, mine planning and mine-life opportunities.

data.title: Kalyon Güneş Reports 75,000-Share Buy-Back
data.description:
Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:KLYPV) ) has shared an announcement.

Kalyon Güneş Teknolojileri Üretim A.Ş. reported that it repurchased 75,000 Class B KLYPV shares on Borsa İstanbul on November 18 under a buy-back program initiated pursuant to a board resolution dated October 19. The shares were bought at prices ranging from TRY 49.72 to TRY 51.30, with an average price of TRY 50.516.

Following buy-backs conducted under a December 9, 2025 board resolution, the company’s holdings reached a nominal TRY 4,869,522, equal to 1.058% of share capital. The program covers up to 5 million shares and a maximum payment of TRY 300 million, with the company stating that its purposes include supporting stable share-price formation, protecting shareholder interests and ensuring the price reflects operational performance.

data.title: Solid Biosciences Updates SGT-001 DMD Gene Therapy Study: What SLDB Investors Should Know
data.description:
Solid Biosciences (SLDB) announced an update on their ongoing clinical study.

Solid Biosciences Inc. (SLDB) updated Study NCT03368742, titled “A Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Single-ascending Dose, Phase I/II Study to Investigate the Safety and Tolerability, and Efficacy of Intravenous SGT-001 in Male Adolescents and Children With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.” The study examined whether one dose of SGT-001 was safe and could help treat Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD).

SGT-001 is an experimental genetic treatment designed to deliver a shortened form of the dystrophin protein to muscle cells. The goal is to address the protein loss that drives muscle damage in people with DMD, a severe inherited muscle disorder.

The trial was planned as an early-stage treatment study in children and teenagers. It began with dose groups and an untreated comparison group, but the control arm was removed after four participants were treated; the updated design was therefore non-randomized, single-group, open-label, and focused on treatment.

The record does not list a study start date, primary completion date, or estimated completion date. It was first submitted on December 5, 2017, while the latest record update was filed on November 16, 2026, and the study is now marked completed.

For SLDB investors, the update offers limited near-term support because no study results were posted. Investor attention is likely to remain on safety findings, evidence of benefit, and the company’s ability to advance SGT-001 in a competitive DMD gene therapy market.

The study record has been updated and is listed as completed, with further details available on the ClinicalTrials.gov portal.

To learn more about SLDB’s potential, visit the Solid Biosciences drug pipeline page.

data.title: Trillion Holding Announces Supplemental Agreement for Acquisition
data.description:
China General Education Group Limited ( (HK:2175) ) has shared an update.

Trillion Holding Group Limited, formerly known as China General Education Group Limited, is involved in an acquisition of a target group operating an art examination training business.

On 18 November 2026, the company, its wholly-owned subsidiary, the vendors and other parties entered into a supplemental agreement revising the acquisition terms. The maximum consideration was reduced from RMB312 million to RMB108 million, while Guangzhou Alliance and Beijing Wener will be excluded as ancillary technology service companies, with their liabilities borne by the vendors; the final consideration will be determined after the target company’s 2026 financial statements are audited.

data.title: Genomed Publishes Delayed Information on Share Sale Terms
data.description:
Genomed S.A. ( (PL:GEN) ) has provided an announcement.

Genomed S.A., based in Warsaw, disclosed delayed inside information concerning agreed key terms for the sale of shares by its major shareholders to Diagnostyka S.A. The disclosure was delayed on 14 October 2026 and published on 18 November 2026 after an agreement governing the sale was executed.

The sellers agreed to sell 622,923 Genomed shares, equal to 47.14% of share capital, at PLN 33 per share. Terms for continued cooperation with key management personnel were also agreed, while detailed transaction agreements remained to be negotiated and signed. The company said earlier disclosure could have harmed transaction prospects, competitiveness and business relations, or misled investors.
